newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices remain steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices remain steady to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued mostly steady to lower on Wednesday as nearby supply outpaced demand, several dealers said.
In the U.S. Northeast, prices had a bearish undertone, pressured by lower feed demand and good flour mill runtimes, a Buffalo dealer said.

"We do have the beginnings of some barley moving into the southern portions of the northeast, Pennsylvania, Delaware and Maryland that are going to affect usage and pricing to some extent on midds," he said. "Barley is an ingredient that does compete with midds this time of the year."
